title: One line of a telemetry recording
description: A recording is JSON Lines, one object per sample a console received, in the order received (NFR-TEST-05): the sample as soc-cloud broadcast it and when the browser got it. Replayed, it feeds the console's tests the same samples at the same intervals, so an incident becomes a test.

received_at_ms.description: When the browser received the sample, Unix milliseconds on its own clock.
